idea-plugin.name: EU AI Act Article 50 Transparency Audit for Your Codebase
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the AI call sites, generation code and system prompts that trigger EU AI Act Article 50 disclosure duties - in force since 2 August 2026.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EU AI Act Article 50 Transparency Audit for Your Codebase: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 28 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/ai-act-article-50-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/ai-act-article-50-audit
